Ravi P: @channel Launch note: we9re previewing a new compact L4p instance class (l4p-compact) for cost-sensitive inference in eu-north-1 and sa-east-1. Preview window next week.
Marta V: what9s different about l4p-compact vs standard l4p?
Ravi P: l4p-compact exposes reduced VRAM and fewer SMs to lower unit cost for small-context models and micro-batching. Expected ~22% lower per-token cost for short-seq workloads.
EngInfra: Ops specifics: tag = "gpu=l4p-compact". Default per-customer cap 20% of pool. No preemptible variant in preview.
SRE-Oncall: Alerts?
Ravi P: two alerts: `dedicated.l4p-compact.capacity_pressure` (fires if pool utilization >75% sustained 10m) and `dedicated.l4p-compact.error_rate` (high init failures). OpsBot will summarize daily during preview.
OpsBot: [automated] Preview reminders scheduled: 7d, 1d, and daily during preview.
EngInfra: helper to list compact instances:
```
redwoodctl instances list --filter "gpu=l4p-compact" --fields id,region,customer_id
```
Billing: pricing = l4p_reserved * 0.78 in preview regions; will appear as `l4p_compact_preview` line item. Prorated credits applied on upgrades.
Support: We'll add console banner and a short FAQ for compatibility (quantization/kv cache differences).
Ravi P: Action items: EngInfra publish AMIs and validation checklist (EOD Tue), SRE add dashboards (EOD Wed), Billing publish preview pricing (EOD Wed), Support prepare FAQ & banner (preview start). Dry-run in staging Fri 09:00 UTC.
Marta V: tagging @Eng-Infra for validation images and QA. Excited to give customers a cheaper small-context option. :tada:
